title: Dipstick Service Adapter Changes
lead: MOC has made improvements to the Dipstick Service Adapter (Part No. 94777). These changes include 2 new dipstick service hoses in 1/4" and 5/16" that are connected by a quick disconnect fitting and can be switched out to meet the user's needs.
body: You will also need to request a Software update for the Smart Tech™ ATF Machine from the Equipment Department.
TO UPDATE YOUR EXISTING DIPSTICK SERVICE ADAPTER:
steps: Remove the brass fitting from the 3-Way manifold.
Apply Teflon tape to the Female Quick Disconnect Coupler (Part No. 94561) and connect it to the 3-Way manifold in the same location you removed the original brass fitting.
The adapter is now ready to be used. When performing a service, select the Dipstick Service Hose you want to use, 94839 or 94841, and connect it to the Female Coupler.
